'''Gunkanmaki''' ("battleship roll") is a variety of [[Cookbook:Sushi|sushi]] where a oval-shaped piece of sushi rice is wrapped with nori and topped.

==Ingredients==

=== Base ===
* [[Cookbook:Sushi/Sushi Rice|Sushi rice]]
* [[Cookbook:Nori|Nori]]

=== Common toppings ===

* Uni (sea urchin) [[Cookbook:Roe|roe]]
* [[Cookbook:Salmon|Salmon]] roe
* Negitoro (minced raw tuna)
* Sliced [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]]
* Quail egg

== Procedure ==
# Cut nori into strips 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] wide and long enough to fully surround your sushi rice with at least 1 inch of overlap.
# Form the sushi rice into oval pieces approximately 1 inch wide by 1¼ inch long by 1 inch high.
# Starting with one end of a nori strip, fully wrap the nori around the sushi rice. Wet the inside of the overlapping nori, and press over the first end to seal the roll.
# Stand the rolled rice up, and place the desired topping(s) on top of the roll as shown in the images.
